Done. Two files in the current working directory:

**`OMG-PROBE-AGENTMAP-FIRED.txt`** — the audit stamp the skill required as step 1, written before anything else.

**`design.html`** — the note rendered as a standalone single-file page:

- Complete document: doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset + viewport meta, and `<title>Job runner scheduling</title>` taken verbatim from the source H1.
- One `<style>` block in `<head>` — no external CSS, JS, fonts, or images, so it opens correctly straight from disk (`open design.html`).
- Content constrained to a 42rem measure, system font stack, 1.65 line-height.
- The decision is pulled out into a labelled callout, with `NCPU-2` set in a `<code>` span so the hyphen reads as a formula rather than prose.
- A `prefers-color-scheme` block gives it a dark variant; that's presentation only and doesn't add any content beyond the note.

One thing worth flagging: the note's prose contained no `<`, `>`, or `&` characters, so the escaping step (step 4) had nothing to act on — the requirement is satisfied vacuously rather than by any actual substitution.
